answer: Audits are recorded in atlas, queued in ferrous, and sable publishes the wait time. A farm of 78 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 27 identities per epoch. A farm of 2571 identities would post 1447 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
